artworks.title: Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Katharine Shepard Fund
artworks.description: This is a black and white drawing of cherubs in an outdoor setting. The scene includes cherubs among clouds near a large tree stump, surrounded by rocks and greenery. The drawing displays intricate details in the cherubs' wings and drapery, contrasting earthy tones in the foreground with an ethereal atmosphere above.

artworks.title: Figure Studies [verso]
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Ruth Sully Curtis)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch on paper with faint drawings that are not deeply detailed. There are partial outlines of two figures, possibly seated, though only parts of the upper body are sketched, providing only a general impression of their posture. The faces of the figures are lightly drawn, with minimal detail such as a suggestion of a nose and lips, and they lack defined expressions or specific hairstyles. The clothing is indicated with a few lines, without specific features. No jewelry or objects being held are visible. The background is plain and unadorned, with some abstract lines and faint numbers or letters inscribed on the lower portion of the drawing, along with a small 'x' mark near the top center. The entire sketch has a rough and unfinished quality.

artworks.title: Men Drinking at a Table [verso]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated gathering with a dog in the foreground. The sketch shows a group seated around a table in a loose, casual setting. The individuals are not clearly defined, suggesting a social or conversational scene. In the foreground, a dog is lying down facing towards the group. The sketch has black ink stains among light pencil lines.

artworks.title: Tree [verso]
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II)
artworks.description: The image depicts a view of a tree from below, showing the dense canopy. The horizon is not visible, with the focus on the tree itself, capturing the intricate overlapping of leaves and branches. The technique used is watercolor, with soft brushstrokes giving it a light quality. The color palette comprises various shades of green for the leaves and brown for the branches against a neutral background. The image conveys lushness and intricacy through the delicate depiction of the tree's foliage.

artworks.title: The Bridge at Grez [verso]
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows rounded and circular shapes layered over a wash of blue and green hues. The shapes resemble arches or tunnels in an abstract manner. Diagonal lines cross the composition, while splotches of brighter green and white are also visible.

artworks.title: Napoleonic Head and Judgment of Paris [verso]
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a human profile and abstract figures. The upper right section shows a detailed profile of a human face with textured pencil strokes. The left side of the drawing contains handwritten notes and scattered pencil marks. In the lower part, there are small figures engaged in dynamic poses with flowing lines and minimal detail. The drawing combines portraiture and abstract figure work.

artworks.title: Man Sitting on a Cask on a Wheelbarrow
artworks.medium: gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated on a wheeled contraption. The individual is facing away from the viewer, wearing a large brimmed hat, a coat with cuffs and breeches, and straps across the back. The person's curly hair extends to the collar, and their feet are visible resting on the apparatus. In the background, there is a stone wall and a faint outline of a landscape with trees and a distant spire or tower. The image has a monochromatic sketch-like quality.

artworks.title: Seated Woman (recto)
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on blue laid paper, squared in red chalk
artworks.description: The image depicts a drawing of a seated woman in profile. She is leaning forward with her arms resting on her knees, and her head slightly bowed. She has curly hair tied back and wears a long, flowing dress with puffed sleeves. The woman is sitting on a pedestal-like structure, with a solid blue background. Sketch lines are visible suggesting unfinished elements in the background.

artworks.title: Mountains [verso]
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist)
artworks.description: The image shows a distant perspective of a mountain range, depicted with delicate and minimal pencil lines. There are no objects directly on the horizon. The brushstrokes are subtle and sparse, suggesting the landscape's contours. The color palette is monochromatic with greys and whites. Closest to us, there is light shading. The background features vast negative space.

artworks.title: Rebel Rifle Pits, Bull Run
artworks.description: The image shows a wooded area with a riverbank in the foreground. A large tree with visible roots and sparse leaves is on the right third of the frame. In the middle ground, a group of leafless trees extends diagonally, leading to a man standing among them. The horizon is high in the composition with barren hill slopes rising up to an overcast sky. The color palette is sepia, giving a vintage feel. The textures and details in the landscape are highlighted against the subdued background. The image is a photograph.

artworks.title: Pietà
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash over black chalk on laid paper

artworks.title: Apollo or Adonis
artworks.medium: charcoal and black chalk on thin wove paper, mounted on heavy laid paper
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a nude male figure standing in a classical contrapposto pose with an elongated object in his right hand and his left hand raised. His hair is curly, and his facial expression appears serene. There is an irregularly shaped column or plinth supporting his stance. The sculpture is in grayscale, suggesting a light-colored material like marble or plaster. It appears life-sized and is highly detailed, emphasizing the figure's anatomical features and muscle structure.

artworks.title: Study for "Greek Girls Bathing" [verso]
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters)
artworks.description: The image displays a sketch of an individual from the waist up. The person has one arm raised near the head and the other arm resting closer to the body. The sketch is in red or orange pastel, indicating short textured hair and softly indicated facial features. The individual wears a form-fitting upper garment. The background is a plain sheet of tan paper with faint, nearly erased text at the top and a small textured piece adhered to the upper edge.

artworks.title: Landscape [verso]
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Margerite A. C. Stewart)
artworks.description: The image depicts a tall, narrow structure to the right side. The landscape recedes into the distance on the left side with a person walking in the distance. The brushstrokes are light and sketch-like with an off-white and grey color palette. Foliage is sketched on the right side of the structure and the left side is more open.

artworks.title: The International Exhibition of 1862 — "The Nave, from the Western Dome"
artworks.description: The image shows a sculpture of a standing female figure with long flowing hair and draped in a cloth. There is an additional smaller figure at her feet. The sculpture is white and placed on a square pedestal. The setting seems to be an exhibition hall with intricate architectural backdrop and various display items around, including other sculptures. The sculpture is centrally positioned among other exhibits in the aisle.

artworks.title: A Young Woman with an Elaborate Hairdo
artworks.medium: graphite with pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 16.7 × 11.2 cm (6 9/16 × 4 7/16 in.) (irregular; monogram on tab)
artworks.description: The image is a pencil drawing of a woman. She is depicted showing her head and shoulders, slightly turned to her left. She has delicate facial features with large eyes, a straight nose, and closed lips. Her hair is styled in a high braid secured with a lace-adorned comb. She wears a dress with a high neckline and pleats, accented with lace trim. The background is plain and light in color.

artworks.title: Verscheÿde Schepen en Gesichten van Amstelredam (Various Ships and Views of Amsterdam): Part III
artworks.medium: complete set of twelve etchings with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The J. and H. Weldon Foundation Inc. and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image consists of a grid of twelve black and white sketches depicting various nautical and maritime scenes. Each sketch shows different vessels, human activities, and coastal environments from a slightly elevated perspective. The scenes are portrayed from the side, with the horizon typically in the upper third. The sketches feature detailed and precise brushstrokes or engravings, creating fine lines and shading for texture and depth. A monochromatic color palette of varying shades of gray is used to provide contrast. The skies show stylized clouds, while the water conveys motion and reflection. The scenes depict ships, people engaging in trade, fishing, or travel in the foreground, while the background includes more water, ships, or coastal landscapes.

artworks.title: Gorge Near Chipigana
artworks.description: The image shows a wooded area with a small depression in the ground. The horizon is not prominently visible. The vegetation and ground below are the main focus. The intricate texture of the foliage is detailed, and the color palette is mostly sepia tones. Fallen logs are visible on a rocky surface, leading towards a darker area where the ground dips. In the distance, the dense foliage creates a richly textured backdrop.

artworks.title: Fort Snelling
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river flowing from left to right. Close by, a grassy area has scattered rocks and a low stone wall where a person, possibly a man wearing a hat, is sitting facing the river. In the distance, there are trees along the riverbanks and a fortification on a cliff, with a tall flagpole visible. The sky is clear. The image is in monochrome with a sepia tint, evoking early photographic styles.

artworks.title: Chesnut Street Theatre, Philadelphia
artworks.description: The image shows a street view of a historic theater building. The perspective is from across the street, looking slightly upward at the facade of the theater. The image focuses on the architectural details of the theater, including classic columns, arched entryways, stonework, and statues in alcoves. The image has a sepia tone, giving it a vintage quality. Posters and signs along the sidewalk advertise performances, adding a sense of cultural activity. Street lamps line the sidewalk, leading the eye down the street towards more buildings in the distance. The color palette is limited to shades of brown and beige.

artworks.title: A Duck and a Stag [verso]
artworks.description: The image shows an uncolored illustration on aged paper featuring two distinct pencil sketches. One sketch of a deer is in the upper left corner, focusing on the animal's form and posture. In the upper right corner, there is a sketch of a duck near water with flowing lines suggesting ripples and hints of grass nearby. The scene appears open and expansive, with a faded beige background, enhancing the pencil sketches. The overall color palette is limited to shades of pencil grey against the warm tone of the paper.

artworks.title: Seated Woman with a Mandolin
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper, laid down on old mount
artworks.description: The image displays a woman seated on a bench, depicted from head to toe. She is turned slightly to her left, holding a lute which is resting on her lap. Her face is in profile, with delicate features, and she has medium-length wavy hair styled beneath an elaborate hat with plumes. She is dressed in an elegant, flowing garment with ruffled edges and detailed fabric patterns, indicating a historical style of dress. The surrounding environment includes a soft cushion behind her and two sheets of paper placed to her left. The background features a textured wall.

artworks.title: Study of an Interior [verso]
artworks.description: The image shows a faint pencil sketch of a person on aged paper. The sketch features a person's upper body turned slightly to the side, near a fireplace or arched structure. The sketch is rough, with unclear facial features and clothing. There are no visible objects or jewelry, and the person appears to be sitting. The background includes an arched architecture element and a suggestion of an interior space. The paper is predominantly blank with smudges and discoloration.

artworks.title: Devastated Landscape [verso]
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist)
artworks.description: The image shows a rural path with trees on either side. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, overlooking the path. The trees have few branches. In the middle of the sketch, there is a horizon with a line of trees and hills. The pencil strokes are light and there is minimal shading. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray and light brown. The trees in the foreground have bare branches. The landscape gradually fades into the distance with subtle details.
